productName: Multiple Care Pro Critical Illness Insurance Plan 2

trends.whatProductOffers: Covers 53 major illnesses, 2 minor illnesses, 1 early-stage critical illness, 4 severe child diseases and female carcinoma-in-situ, with protection up to age 100.

keyFigures.label: Conditions covered
keyFigures.condition: 53 major, 2 minor, 1 early stage, 4 severe child diseases plus female carcinoma-in-situ

keyFigures.label: Coverage term
keyFigures.condition: Excluding Loss of Independent Existence; Tier 1 major illnesses to age 85

exclusionsOrConditions: Loss of Independent Existence is excluded from the age-100 cover.
51 major illnesses under Tier 1 are covered to age 85, not 100.
Definitions and waiting periods are in the policy.
trends.talkingPointTemplate: For {client_detail}, 61 conditions including early-stage and child diseases are covered under one policy.
verificationPrompts: Ask which conditions concern the client most
Check whether cover to age 100 matters
Confirm the client understands the tier ages
sourceEvidence: "covers 53 major illnesses, 2 minor illnesses, 1 early stage critical illness and 4 severe child diseases and female Carcinoma-in-situ"
"provides critical illness protection up to the age of 100"
trends.notesForReviewer: The extract shows Tier 1 major illness cover to age 85 while overall cover runs to age 100.

trends.whatProductOffers: Pays up to 500% of the critical illness protection amount across five tiers and five illness groups, with up to three claims for cancer.

keyFigures.label: Cancer claims
keyFigures.condition: One claim per group for other groups

exclusionsOrConditions: One claim per major illness group, except cancer which allows up to 3.
Advance payments reduce the current sum assured.
clientSignalPhrases: wants cover after the first claim
clientProfileFit: Clients with family history of multiple cancers
trends.talkingPointTemplate: Given {client_detail}, the policy can pay up to five times the sum assured across separate illness groups.
verificationPrompts: Confirm understanding of the 3-claim cancer cap
Check the sum assured the client wants
sourceEvidence: "You will receive as much as 500% of the critical illness protection amount that you have purchased."
"for which you can claim up to a maximum of 3 times"

trends.whatProductOffers: A participating plan that accumulates annual dividends with interest and may pay a one-off terminal dividend after the policy has been in force for 10 years.
exclusionsOrConditions: Dividends and the terminal dividend are non-guaranteed.
The terminal dividend requires 10 years in force.
Returns depend on investment and claims experience.
trends.talkingPointTemplate: Since {client_detail}, the participating structure adds non-guaranteed dividends on top of the CI cover.
verificationPrompts: Ask whether cash value access matters
sourceEvidence: "Annual Dividends, which have accumulated with interest under this policy"
"a one-off non-guaranteed cash amount, called a Terminal Dividend, provided that the policy has been in force for 10 years"

trends.whatProductOffers: Pays a death benefit of the current sum assured plus accumulated annual dividends and any terminal dividend, and adds a compassionate cash benefit of 4% or 5% of the initial sum assured.

keyFigures.label: Death benefit
keyFigures.value: Current sum assured + accumulated annual dividends + terminal dividend
keyFigures.condition: Terminal dividend if policy in force 10 years

keyFigures.label: Compassionate cash
keyFigures.condition: Depends on the CI protection amount purchased

exclusionsOrConditions: The compassionate cash percentage depends on the protection amount.
The terminal dividend is non-guaranteed and requires 10 years.
Current sum assured is reduced by advance payments.
clientSignalPhrases: wants a legacy for the kids
clientProfileFit: Those wanting immediate cash for family
trends.talkingPointTemplate: With {client_detail}, the death benefit returns the sum assured plus dividends, with extra compassionate cash for immediate costs.
sourceEvidence: "Current Sum Assured; Annual Dividends ... and a one-off non-guaranteed cash amount, called a Terminal Dividend"
"compassionate cash benefit, which equals to 4% or 5% of the Initial Sum Assured"
